chests.evidence: Big chest, GetEventName InsideTheDekuTree_GetMap, DefaultDungeonRoomIndex 0 (remake room 0 = main lobby, prefab Room_A with the floor web and wall Skulltulas), y=108.4, one floor above the lobby floor (~100): the 2F ledge, as on N64.
Big chest, GetEventName InsideTheDekuTree_GetCompass, room 3 (prefab Room_D_b6c3, the highest room y~120 with Deku Babas, big Skulltula and a GS). Top floor of the tree, as the N64 3F compass room.

Only small chest in room 3 (same room index as the compass chest). It sits 17 m west of and 5 m above the compass chest (-65.2,125.6,0), and the way there passes a crawlspace (CrawlAnchor pair at x=-52.8/-57.8, y=120.3, right behind the compass chest). The identity is sure; the crawl requirement is new versus SoH (it only matters with crawl shuffle). Contents changed (recovery heart -> TBox_DekuNutBundle).
Big chest, GetEventName InsideTheDekuTree_GetSlingShot, room 2 (prefab Room_C_efa7).

Only small chest in room 2 (same AiGroup Room_C_efa7 as the slingshot chest), on the upper ledge at y=116.2: 4 m above the slingshot chest (112.0) and ~11 m above the pit grass (104.9). A Skullwalltula (they sit on vine walls) is 5 m away at y=114.5, which fits SoH's climb rule. The remake also adds a FallingLadder (event InsideTheDekuTree_Gimmick_FallingLadder) that an eye switch drops next to that ledge, an alternative route (CanHitEyeTargets). SoH's rule stays sufficient if the vines are there (see open questions). Contents changed (heart -> TBox_DekuNutBundle).

Only chest in room 4, the lowest regular room (y=79.4, water plane, Deku Babas, basement GSs at y 78.7/86.9) = N64 B1. The identity is high. In the remake it sits 1.9 m behind a wall web (Obj_InsideTheDekuTree_SpiderWeb_A_02), next to a switch candle (Obj_SwitchCandleStick_A_02) and a step switch, all driven by the event InsideTheDekuTree_Gimmick_CandleAndSpiderWeb: the candle burns the web. It is unknown whether the step switch lights the candle by itself, so the condition conservatively asks for a way to light it (SoH's usual torch helper). SoH: OPEN_CHEST only. Contents changed (heart -> Item_DekuStickBundle_Small).

Big chest, GetEventName DodongoCavern_GetMap, room 1 (remake room 1 = the big lobby: 3 Beamos, the lift MoveFloor, stone tablets), at floor level y=100.25, right behind a bombable wall (WallCrack at -23.25,99.75,-38, 3 m away). A lobby bomb flower is 12 m away (the Goron bracelet route, as in SoH).

Big chest, GetEventName DodongoCavern_GetCompass, room 11 (Armos statues + an Amos), entered from the stairs room (room 10) through the bombable wall at (-49,101.7,-14): the N64 compass room off the lower stairs.
Big chest, GetEventName Get_StoneOfFire_GetBombBag, room 13 (the moving-spike room), on its upper ledge at y=115.7.

The other chest of room 13 (the bomb bag room): small (A_06), 2.4 m above the room floor (MoveSpike blades at y=110.8) on a platform, with a bomb flower 6.9 m away (49.25,113.95,-11.75): the N64 bomb flower platform. Contents changed (red rupee -> Deku Shield, or Deku seeds as substitute).

In room 1 (lobby) but at y=113.3, the lobby's top floor, right behind a bombable wall (WallCrack at -19.75,113.28,-36.5, 1 m). It is 21 m from the top-floor stone tablet Obj_DodongoCave_StoneTablet_A_02 (0,116.25,-33.7), the spot of RC_DODONGOS_CAVERN_TOP_FLOOR_PEDESTAL. It holds a Deku Shield, like N64's end-of-bridge chest.

Remake-new. Small chest on the lobby floor (room 1, y=100) behind a bombable wall (WallCrack at -22.75,99.75,-8, 7 m, with a Room_01 wall piece in between), the mirror of the map-chest alcove. N64's lobby has only the map chest. The rule mirrors the map chest's without its Goron-bracelet branch, which is conservative: the nearest lobby bomb flower is 21 m away. A Beamos with IsHeadShootingToTargetOnDie stands 9 m away and may also break the wall.

Remake-new. Room 10 = the stairs room (16 bomb flowers + BrokenStair, the door to Armos room 12 at the top, the compass-room wall at the bottom, the vines GS). The chest is at the far south end at y=116, behind a bombable wall (WallCrack at -49,115.83,-63.97), at the top of a ladder (Land_DodongoCave_Ladder_A_04 centred at y=108.2, so it likely runs from the floor ~100.4 up to ~116). No bomb flower is near that ledge. The region and the ladder are inferred from the ladder's centre height.

Remake-new. NoBake chest on a pedestal (Obj_TBoxPedestal_A_01, PushAirWall_Box) in room 5 (two Enemy_MiddleBoss_Lizalfos, y~100). EventRequestActor DodongoCavern_Gimmick_DefeatLizalfos01 in AiGroup Gimmick_DodongoCavern_MiddleBoss01 references it, so it appears when the lower Lizalfos pair is beaten. N64 has no chest there.

Remake-new. NoBake chest on a pedestal in room 16 (y~115, the second Enemy_MiddleBoss_Lizalfos pair, between slingshot rooms 14/15 and 17). EventRequestActor DodongoCavern_Gimmick_DefeatLizalfos02 references it, so it appears when the upper Lizalfos fight is won. In the remake the two Lizalfos fights are separate rooms (5 lower, 16 upper).

Big NoBake chest, Item_Boomerang, GetEventName InsideJabuJabuBelly_TreasureBoxWithRuto09, in room 9, whose AiGroup has exactly 4 Enemy_Stinger. EventRequestActor InsideJabuJabuBelly_TreasureBoxAppear makes it appear when they die: SoH's 'kill 4 Stingers (or Ruto)' rule.

Big NoBake chest, Item_Dungeon_Compass, GetEventName InsideJabuJabuBelly_TreasureBoxWithRuto12, in room 12, whose AiGroup has exactly 9 Enemy_Shabom_AlwaysRespawn and an enemy counter. It appears on InsideJabuJabuBelly_Room12_TreasureBoxAppear: SoH's 'kill 9 Shabom' rule.

The dungeon map, but MOVED. On N64/SoH it is in the west fork room, behind a tentacle; the remake's tentacle rooms (8 green, 10 red, 11 blue) hold only the tentacle. This one is an ordinary always-present big chest (no links, no event) in room 14 = the water-switch room (a pit with the underwater StepSwitch_A_04 and WaterPlaneDynamic, the wall GS above the pots ledge, a hit-switch above the door). It is at main-floor height y=77.55 on the side of the door to room 18 (the lift room's lower level). Matched as the map chest by item and chest type; its location rule is replaced.

Remake-new. Small chest in room 13 = the B1 'jiggly' room (entered from holes basement room 3; water at y=81.5, Obj_InsideJabu_Jabu_SwayingFloor_A_01 at 78.95, 2 Octoroks). It is on the far ledge (y=82.47), 1-2 m from the room's 4 pots: SoH's 'B1 Jiggly Pots' region. The entry ledge with climbable ivy is across the water. SoH reaches that ledge only with hovers, megajump or bomb recoil; a chest placed there suggests the remake has a normal route, so this rule is likely too strict (but safe).

Main room (room 1, y=100), at x=-11 (left of the entrance axis; the entrance is at +z) on the front side, 3.4 m behind fake wall Obj_Well_GlassTruth_A_09 (-11,100,-2.03; GlassTruthDisappearObj), which faces the front corridor. It mirrors the key chest behind A_03 on the right. N64 has a small key here; the remake has a red rupee (the remake has 2 keys, not 3).

Main room, right side (x=10.6), 3.4 m behind fake wall Obj_Well_GlassTruth_A_03 (14,100,-4.53, turned to face the east corridor). It holds the remake's only small key in a chest; N64's right fake-wall chest also holds a key. 'Bottom' (south on the map) does not quite fit: the alcove is in the front half.

Main room front-centre (-0.2, y=96.19, -5.0), 3.4 m below water planes Obj_WaterPlane_A_01 (y 99.64/97.83). Their Presence is negated by the flag BottomOfTheWell_Room_01_Blow_Ocarina, which the event BottomOfTheWell_Gimmick:WaterLevel_Down sets after Zelda's Lullaby at Obj_TriForcePoint_A_10: SoH's LOGIC_BOTW_LOWERED_WATER. It is the remake's only underwater chest.

Main room back-left corner (-29.6,100,-37.0), at the end of a corridor (room-1 Area at -25.5,100,-37) closed by two fake walls in a row (Obj_Well_GlassTruth_A_06/A_08), under a hanging Skulltula. The remake BotW has no bombable walls at all (no WallCrack/CrackWall on B1), so the explosives part of SoH's rule is dropped and the lens part kept.

Inside the central block (x=12, z=-11), on one line with the big hanging Skulltula (4.5,103.8,-11.0, 7.5 m away) and the compass pedestal. The room-1 Area at (-0.6,100,-10.9), scale 14x4, spans the compass, the Skulltula and this chest: SoH's Middle with the centre Skulltula. Contents changed (nuts -> blue rupee).

Big chest, GetEventName BottomOfTheWell_GetCompass, on a pedestal in the central block between fake walls GlassTruth_A_12 (2.6 m) and A_11 (5.7 m), above an area of pits into B3 (a room-9 DungeonRoomArea lies under it).

Remake-new, or possibly the Like-Like chest moved. Small chest in a sunken trench on the main room's east side (y=97.81; trench pots at y=97.35; Land_Well_Ladder_A_06 4 m away to climb back out), just outside the bars of the Like-Like cage (room 7's strips at x=20.9-22; the LikeLike is 10 m away). Room 7 itself (Like Like + GS) has no chest in the remake. This chest is not behind a fake wall.

The only invisible chest (Obj_TBox_GlassTruth_A_01), but MOVED. SoH puts it in the Dead Hand room; here it is in room 2, reached by the crawlspace behind the waterfalls (CrawlAnchor 0,98.8,-60) that leads on to the Dead Hand room, on an upper ledge at y=105.8 by fake wall GlassTruth_A_31. Same lens rule as SoH; only the region changes.

Remake-new. Room 11, a balcony above the Dead Hand room (y=102.2 vs 92.3), entered from room 2 through a door at (0,102.17,-89). The chest is at its end, behind fake wall Obj_Well_GlassTruth_A_30 (-97.56, 2.9 m away). N64 has nothing like it.
Only big chest of room 9 (the B3 basement, y~87: dirty water, 3 ReDeads, 8 Obj_BrokenRock_A_01 boulders, 5 silver rupees). The B3 map chest behind boulders, as in SoH.
Room 6 (3 Enemy_Keese_Fire, a Beamos, fake floors GlassTruth_A_14/15/16), the room before Like-Like cage room 7. It holds a Deku Shield (A_06), as on N64.
Big NoBake chest, Item_GlassTruth, GetEventName BottomOfTheWell_GetGlassTruth, in room 8 with Enemy_DeadHand + 4 hands. It appears on BottomOfTheWell_08_Enemy_WipedOut.
Big chest, Item_Dungeon_Map, frozen in red ice (Obj_RedIce_A_01 links FrozenInIce to it): SoH's blue-fire map chest.

Big chest, Item_Dungeon_Compass, in room 6 (GS, Sun's Song fairy, a red ice block freezing two pots). Unlike on N64 it is NOT frozen (no FrozenInIce link to it), so SoH's BlueFire on the chest is redundant here. That is harmless: SoH's way into the room already needs blue fire.

Big NoBake chest, Item_HeavyBoot, GetEventName SageOfWater_MelodyGet_Water (the Serenade of Water scene with Sheik). It appears on TreasureBoxAppear_Room04 after the Enemy_Wolfos_White in its AiGroup.

Remake-new. Room 8 = the push-block room (Obj_SliderBox, 5 silver rupees, a door locked by the rupee counter). The chest at (-53.1,107.2,-34.2) is 13 m from the blue-fire pedestal (-54.0,103.9,-20.9, SoH's Fire Nook), at the end of 3 Obj_SongOfTimeBlock_A_01 laid in a line between them. They are controlled by Obj_SongOfTimeSign_A_01 with isDefaultActive=false, so the blocks appear only with the Song of Time. This SoH tree already gives the Fire Nook's rupees a Song of Time rule.

soh_chests_without_remake_counterpart.evidence: The remake keeps King Dodongo inside the DodongoCavern map (room 22: Enemy_DungeonBoss_Dodongo, heart container, warp; room 21 before it has the crack floor). Neither of those rooms nor any other DC room has a chest left over: all 9 DC chests are matched or explained (4 are remake-new).

There is no bombable wall anywhere on B1 of the remake (no WallCrack/CrackWall/BrokenRock actors above y=93), and the front-centre spot is the drained pool that holds the underwater-front chest. All 7 small chests of room 1 are assigned.
Only one chest in the remake BotW is under water (the front pool). The west moat by the crypt door (Obj_WaterPlaneDynamic_A_01 at -32.2,99.9,-18.4) has no chest near it.

Room 7 (Enemy_LikeLike + its GS, behind the door from fire-keese room 6) has no chest. The nearest chest (12988877782812797760, in the east trench just outside the cage bars) is kept as remake-new; it may be meant as the replacement (see open questions).

divergences.what: Bottom of the Well has 2 small keys and 2 locked doors (N64/SoH: 3 and 3).
divergences.evidence: Keys: one in a chest (8397646530660039355, the right fake-wall alcove) and one Obj_Dungeon_SmallKey in the crypt (room 3, -62.3,100.9,-18.5 = RC_BOTTOM_OF_THE_WELL_FREESTANDING_KEY). Locked doors (Obj_DoorChainLock_A_01, two lock pieces per door, both referenced by the door's Obj_Well_SwitchShutter_A_01): (-10.22,100,-22.52) into room 5 (Deku Baba + GS = Skull Wall Room, the west inner room) and (11.26,100,-22.49) into room 4 (Keese + GS = Invisible Path, the east inner room). Neither inner room holds a key, so both keys can be reached before any lock.
divergences.proposed_rule: dungeon.cpp: BOTTOM_OF_THE_WELL vanillaKeyCount 3 -> 2. Exit overrides, each replacing SmallKeys(SCENE_BOTTOM_OF_THE_WELL, 3): RR_BOTW_MIDDLE->RR_BOTW_SKULL_WALL_ROOM, RR_BOTW_MIDDLE->RR_BOTW_INVISIBLE_PATH, RR_BOTW_SKULL_WALL_ROOM->RR_BOTW_MIDDLE, RR_BOTW_INVISIBLE_PATH->RR_BOTW_MIDDLE: logic->SmallKeys(SCENE_BOTTOM_OF_THE_WELL, 2)

divergences.what: Bottom of the Well: the hidden-pits (fire keese) room is no longer behind a locked door, and there is no crawlspace in front of it.
divergences.evidence: Room 6's door from the main room (Obj_Well_SwitchShutter_A_01 at 21.39,100,-37.05) links only a PushAirWall_DoorFront: no Obj_DoorChainLock. The way to it from the SE corner passes fake wall Obj_Well_GlassTruth_A_04 (15.08,100,-37.97). The remake has only two crawlspaces (behind the waterfalls, and in the front pool), neither at that corner.
divergences.proposed_rule: Exit overrides: RR_BOTW_CORNER_CRAWLSPACE->RR_BOTW_HIDDEN_PITS_ROOM: ctx->GetTrickOption(RT_LENS_BOTW) || logic->CanUse(RG_LENS_OF_TRUTH) (was SmallKeys(...,3)); RR_BOTW_HIDDEN_PITS_ROOM->RR_BOTW_CORNER_CRAWLSPACE: ctx->GetTrickOption(RT_LENS_BOTW) || logic->CanUse(RG_LENS_OF_TRUTH) (was SmallKeys(...,3) && lens). Optionally RR_BOTW_PERIMETER->RR_BOTW_CORNER_CRAWLSPACE: true (was CanUse(RG_CRAWL); this only matters with crawl shuffle).

divergences.what: Bottom of the Well key placement: the vanilla keys are now in the right fake-wall chest and the crypt; the front-left fake-wall chest holds a red rupee.
divergences.evidence: 8975637636514249074 (front-left fake wall) drops TBox_Rupee_Red; 8397646530660039355 (right fake wall) drops Item_Dungeon_SmallKey; the crypt has Obj_Dungeon_SmallKey.
divergences.proposed_rule: No logic change. For vanilla or own-dungeon key placement, RC_BOTTOM_OF_THE_WELL_FRONT_LEFT_FAKE_WALL_CHEST's vanilla item becomes a red rupee (one RG_BOTTOM_OF_THE_WELL_SMALL_KEY fewer in the pool).

divergences.what: The Bottom of the Well back-left chest is behind fake walls only (no bombable wall).
divergences.evidence: Two Disappear-type GlassTruth walls (A_06, A_08) close its corridor, and there is no bombable-wall actor anywhere on B1.

divergences.what: The Bottom of the Well invisible chest moved out of the Dead Hand room into the room before it.
divergences.evidence: Obj_TBox_GlassTruth_A_01 is in room 2 (on the y=105.8 ledge), between the waterfall crawlspace and the Dead Hand room; room 8 (Dead Hand) holds only the lens chest.
divergences.proposed_rule: Move location RC_BOTTOM_OF_THE_WELL_INVISIBLE_CHEST from RR_BOTW_DEAD_HAND_ROOM to RR_BOTW_NEAR_BOSS_UPPER, with rule (ctx->GetTrickOption(RT_LENS_BOTW) || logic->CanUse(RG_LENS_OF_TRUTH)) && logic->HasItem(RG_OPEN_CHEST)

divergences.what: The Jabu-Jabu map chest moved to the water-switch room and no longer needs a tentacle.
divergences.evidence: 14933854942830098290 is an ordinary big chest in room 14 (the water-switch room); tentacle rooms 8/10/11 contain only Enemy_Tentacle_* and its fuse.
divergences.proposed_rule: Move location RC_JABU_JABUS_BELLY_MAP_CHEST from RR_JABU_JABUS_BELLY_FORK_WEST (rule LOGIC_JABU_WEST_TENTACLE && CanOpenLargeChest) to RR_JABU_JABUS_BELLY_WATER_SWITCH_ROOM_SOUTH, with rule logic->CanOpenLargeChest()

divergences.what: The Deku Tree basement chest is behind a web that a switch candle burns.
divergences.evidence: Obj_InsideTheDekuTree_SpiderWeb_A_02 is 1.9 m from the chest, with Obj_SwitchCandleStick_A_02 and Obj_StepSwitch_A_05 beside it, all referenced by EventRequestActor InsideTheDekuTree_Gimmick_CandleAndSpiderWeb.
divergences.proposed_rule: Location rule (replaces): RC_DEKU_TREE_BASEMENT_CHEST: (logic->HasFireSourceWithTorch() || logic->CanUse(RG_FAIRY_BOW)) && logic->HasItem(RG_OPEN_CHEST). This is conservative; it goes back to logic->HasItem(RG_OPEN_CHEST) if the step switch lights the candle by itself.

divergences.what: The Deku Tree compass-room side chest is past a crawlspace.
divergences.evidence: A CrawlAnchor pair at (-52.75/-57.8, 120.34, 0) lies between the compass chest (x=-48.3) and the side chest (x=-65.2).
divergences.proposed_rule: Location rule (replaces): RC_DEKU_TREE_COMPASS_ROOM_SIDE_CHEST: logic->CanUse(RG_CRAWL) && logic->HasItem(RG_OPEN_CHEST) (no effect unless crawl is shuffled)

divergences.what: Dodongo's Cavern: two new chests appear after the Lizalfos fights, two more new ones sit behind bombable walls, and King Dodongo's room has no chest.
divergences.evidence: EventRequestActors DodongoCavern_Gimmick_DefeatLizalfos01/02 reference NoBake chests on pedestals in rooms 5 and 16; chests behind WallCracks sit in the lobby (room 1) and the stairs room (room 10); the boss rooms 21/22 have no chest.
divergences.proposed_rule: New locations: the lobby chest in RR_DODONGOS_CAVERN_LOBBY: logic->CanBreakMudWalls() && logic->HasItem(RG_OPEN_CHEST); the stairs chest in RR_DODONGOS_CAVERN_STAIRS_LOWER: logic->CanClimbLadder() && logic->CanBreakMudWalls() && logic->HasItem(RG_OPEN_CHEST); the lower Lizalfos chest in RR_DODONGOS_CAVERN_LOWER_LIZALFOS: logic->Get(LOGIC_DC_KILLED_LOWER_LIZALFOS) && logic->HasItem(RG_OPEN_CHEST); the upper Lizalfos chest in RR_DODONGOS_CAVERN_UPPER_LIZALFOS: logic->CanKillEnemy(RE_LIZALFOS, ED_CLOSE, true, 2) && logic->HasItem(RG_OPEN_CHEST). Remove RC_DODONGOS_CAVERN_BOSS_ROOM_CHEST from the pool.

divergences.what: The Ice Cavern compass chest is not frozen in red ice.
divergences.evidence: No Obj_RedIce links FrozenInIce to 13542013937093159888 (the map chest's red ice does link to the map chest); room 6's red ice (A_06) freezes two pots instead.
divergences.proposed_rule: Optional location rule (replaces): RC_ICE_CAVERN_COMPASS_CHEST: (logic->IsChild || logic->CanClearStalagmite() || ctx->GetTrickOption(RT_ICE_STALAGMITE_CLIP)) && logic->CanOpenLargeChest(). No practical change while RR_ICE_CAVERN_HUB->RR_ICE_CAVERN_COMPASS_ROOM needs BlueFire().

open_questions_for_in_game_check: Jabu B1 jiggly room (room 13, Octoroks + swaying floor): can a child reach the pots ledge with the small chest (red rupee) without hover boots? If yes, its rule can be relaxed (and SoH's B1_JIGGLY->B1_JIGGLY_POTS exit too).

Bottom of the Well, east trench chest (blue rupee, below floor level just outside the Like-Like cage bars): can it be reached from the main room without the lens, and is it clearly the Like-Like chest's replacement?
Bottom of the Well: is the key chest the one through the fake wall on the right side near the front (N64 calls it 'right bottom'), and the rupee chest the front-left one?
Deku Tree basement: does stepping on the floor switch by the webbed chest light the candle and burn the web by itself, or must Link bring fire?
Deku Tree slingshot room: can the side-chest ledge be climbed by vines, or only by the ladder dropped by shooting the eye switch?
Dodongo's Cavern stairs room: can the ladder to the new chest (south end, y~116) be climbed from the room floor before the stairs fall?
Bottom of the Well room 11 (the balcony above Dead Hand): does its chest really need the lens (fake wall), and is it reached from the room before Dead Hand without climbing?
